name: brawl-helper
description: Brawl Helper - unofficial Brawl Stars companion

scripts.mobile:add: npm run mobile:prepare && npx cap add android
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run mobile:prepare && npx cap sync android
scripts.mobile:open: npm run mobile:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.mobile:run: npm run mobile:sync && npx cap run android
scripts.mobile:build:debug: npm run mobile:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.mobile:build:release: npm run mobile:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
